messages.author: aishen.free.fr
messages.body:
Hi,
I am doing this jnb :
https://ambermd.org/tutorials/analysis/tutorial_notebooks/real_simview/index.php
It works fine, thank you very much.
Is there a way  to reverse to DNA alphabet (ATCG) the sequence
x = sequence {TYR TYR ASP PRO GLU THR GLY THR TRP TYR}
another way that by hand ?
Best
Henri
